description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Savings Accounts API in the Apache Fineract project, including request/response models and nested data structures.

classes.name: SavingsAccountsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes representing Swagger API models for savings account operations.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response model for retrieving savings account templates, including client info and product options.

classes.name: GetSavingsProductOptions
classes.description: Represents options for savings products with id and name.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountsResponse
classes.description: Main response model for listing savings accounts, including pagination and detailed account info.

classes.name: GetSavingsPageItems
classes.description: Contains individual savings account item details.

classes.name: GetSavingsStatus
classes.description: Status details of a savings account, including id, code, value, and boolean flags.

classes.name: GetSavingsTimeline
classes.description: Timeline information for savings account status changes and approvals.

classes.name: GetSavingsCurrency
classes.description: Currency details associated with a savings account.

classes.name: GetSavingsInterestCompoundingPeriodType
classes.description: Interest compounding period type details.

classes.name: GetSavingsInterestPostingPeriodType
classes.description: Interest posting period type details.

classes.name: GetSavingsInterestCalculationType
classes.description: Interest calculation type details.

classes.name: GetSavingsInterestCalculationDaysInYearType
classes.description: Interest calculation days in year type details.

classes.name: GetSavingsSummary
classes.description: Summary info for a savings account, including currency and balance.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsRequest
classes.description: Model for creating a new savings account request.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsResponse
classes.description: Response after creating a savings account, including IDs.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Detailed response for a specific savings account by ID.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountsSummary
classes.description: Summary info for a specific savings account, including balances.

classes.name: PutSavingsAccountsAccountIdRequest
classes.description: Model for updating savings account interest rate.

classes.name: PutSavingsAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Response after updating savings account interest rate.

classes.name: PutSavingsAccountsChanges
classes.description: Changes made during interest rate update.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsAccountIdRequest
classes.description: Model for setting dates and withdrawal options for a savings account.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Response after setting dates for a savings account.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsAccountIdChanges
classes.description: Changes made during date setting.

classes.name: DeleteSavingsAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Response after deleting or closing a savings account.
